questions.question_text: In the bedroom scene, a woman in a black dress is pouring a drink. When she hears someone approaching the door, what specific action does she take with the bottle she is holding?

options.A: She throws it out the window.
options.B: She hides it under the pillow/bedding.
options.C: She places it openly on the table.
options.D: She hands it to the person entering.

questions.temporal_anchor: At the bottom of the stairs
questions.question_text: A woman finishes grooming herself in the bedroom and exits into the hallway. As she descends the staircase, who is waiting for her at the bottom?

options.B: A man in a dark formal suit.
options.C: A group of soldiers.
options.D: No one; the hall is empty.

questions.question_text: In the carriage scene, a woman is speaking emotionally about her son. Although she is wearing a heavy dark coat and a black veil, what color is the dress visible underneath her coat?

options.B: White.
options.C: Grey.

questions.question_text: The woman in the black dress drinks brandy in her room. To disguise the smell before leaving to meet her visitor, what does she gargle with?

options.B: Cologne/Perfume.
options.C: Hot tea.

questions.question_text: A man in a suit watches a woman descend the stairs. When she reaches him, what is the first physical contact he initiates?

options.B: He shakes her hand formally.
options.C: He takes her hand and kisses it.
options.D: He places his hands on her shoulders.

questions.question_text: In the parlor, the woman in the black dress begins to cry. What object does the man in the suit provide for her?

options.B: A white handkerchief.
options.C: A chair to sit on.

questions.question_text: Two women are sitting inside a carriage. Where is the woman with the black lace veil positioned relative to the other woman?

options.A: She is sitting directly beside her.
options.B: She is sitting opposite/across from her.
options.C: She is standing outside the carriage door.

questions.question_text: The woman who was previously seen in her bedroom now stands in the parlor. What distinctive jewelry is she wearing on the collar of her black dress?

options.B: A large cameo brooch.
options.C: A diamond necklace.

questions.question_text: During the conversation in the parlor, the man in the suit sarcastically asks if his feeling can be 'love'. What physical position does he take while asking this?

options.B: He kneels on one knee.
options.C: He lies down on the sofa.
options.D: He turns his back to her.

questions.question_text: A maid enters the bedroom after the woman hides the bottle. Where does the maid stand while delivering her message?

options.B: She stands near the open door.
options.C: She sits on the bed.

questions.question_text: In the carriage, identifying the woman sitting opposite the one with the veil: what type of headwear is she wearing?

options.B: A dark bonnet tied under the chin.
options.C: A diamond tiara.

questions.question_text: In the bedroom, the woman in the black dress pours and drinks a glass of dark liquid. Immediately after finishing it, what does she do?

options.B: She wipes her mouth with a handkerchief/cloth.
options.C: She throws the glass against the wall.

questions.question_text: The man in the suit kneels to propose to the woman in black. How does she react physically to his proposal?

options.B: She tells him to get up and pulls her hand away/looks annoyed.
options.C: She faints.
options.D: She laughs and claps her hands.

questions.question_text: The woman in the bedroom picks up a cologne bottle to rinse her mouth. After using it, where does she place the bottle?

options.A: She puts it in her pocket.
options.B: She places it back on the vanity table.
options.C: She drops it on the floor.
options.D: She hands it to the maid.

questions.question_text: While the maid is speaking to her in the bedroom, what is the woman in the black dress doing?

options.B: She is adjusting her hair and collar in the mirror.
options.C: She is lying on the bed crying.

questions.question_text: After the man in the suit rises from kneeling, he continues to speak to the woman. Does he walk away to the other side of the room?

options.A: Yes, he walks to the fireplace.
options.B: No, he remains standing close to her.
options.C: Yes, he exits the room immediately.
options.D: He sits down on a chair.

questions.question_text: Identify the man waiting at the bottom of the stairs. When seen in close-up during the conversation, what facial hair does he have?

options.B: A pencil mustache.
options.C: He is clean-shaven.

questions.question_text: In the carriage, do the two women (one in a bonnet, one with a veil) shake hands or embrace before the scene ends?

options.B: Yes, they shake hands.
options.C: No, they remain seated without physical contact.

questions.question_text: When the man in the suit initially greets the woman at the bottom of the stairs, he comments on her appearance. What does the woman do in response?

options.B: She pretends to cry/dabs her eyes with a handkerchief.
options.C: She laughs.

questions.question_text: A man is waiting for the woman to descend the stairs. What is the style of the neckwear he is wearing with his suit?

options.B: A wide dark cravat/tie with a pin.
options.C: An open collar with no tie.
